bookingCreation.notes: Creates booking with flow_type='payment', status='pending'. New booking on every retry.

cancellation.notes: Cancel only while status IN ('pending'). Zero-row re-read + already_confirmed/cancelled/fail-closed.

customerSpend.notes: Durable per-payment marker. Called from processSuccessfulPayment.

postCompletion.notes: skipCustomerSpend=true. skipLoyalty NOT set (see #167 known gap).

providerVerification.notes: I've Paid converges through canonical Payment Authority.

retryPaymentGate.notes: Only definitive not_paid authorizes replacement checkout. No-reference fails closed.

forbiddenWrites: customer_profiles.total_spent — use apply_payment_spend_once (raw mutation removed in PR #169)
Standalone notifyOwnerNewPayment from I've Paid — handled by Stage 3

sessionKeys.persistence: CAS via update_session_cas. Direct update for payment step advance.
sessionKeys.cleanup: Session deactivated by Stage 3. _payment_retry_blocked persisted via persistSessionDataOnFailure.
